author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/44-mobile-app.md — REQ-4, AC-4 + decomposition PR 6.

## Surface
- New migration: `oncall_schedule` table (id UUID PK, moderator_id, starts_at, ends_at, role ENUM('primary', 'backup'))
- New endpoint: `GET /api/oncall/current?role=primary` → returns `{ moderator_id, phone_number_e164? }` for the moderator on duty
- Phone number storage: extend `moderators` table with `phone_e164 TEXT?` column (with privacy notes — visible only to other moderators, never federated)
- Mobile UI: "Call senior" button on case view → `Linker::open(format!("tel:{phone}"))` (Tauri shell command) or `<a href="tel:...">` (PWA).

## Rust-quality notes
- **Phone number storage is sensitive.** Per rust-quality §6: encode in `polaris-types` as a `PhoneE164(String)` newtype, not raw `String`. Validation in the constructor (`PhoneE164::new(s: &str) -> Result<Self, PhoneError>`).
- **Privacy boundary**: phone numbers NEVER appear in audit log dumps or federation records. The mapping layer (#103) explicitly strips this field if it's ever referenced from federation paths.
- **`tel:` URL escaping** — phone numbers must be properly URL-encoded. Per OWASP, never paste a moderator-supplied string into a URL without `urlencoding::encode`. Even though phone numbers are operator-provisioned, defense-in-depth.
- **The `Linker::open` (Tauri) / `window.open(tel:…)` (PWA) call MUST NOT escape the platform's safe-list of URL schemes.** Tauri config requires `tel` to be in the allowlist; never use `shell::execute` for this.
- Per rust-quality §3 (handler discipline): on-call lookup returns `404 NotFound` with code `oncall_unconfigured` if no schedule entry covers `now()`; mobile UI surfaces this clearly (don't open a `tel:` URL with empty number).

## External references
- E.164 phone format: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164
- Tauri shell allowlist: https://v2.tauri.app/security/permissions/
- iOS `tel:` URL handling: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/featuredarticles/iPhoneURLScheme_Reference/PhoneLinks/PhoneLinks.html
- Android `ACTION_DIAL` intent: https://developer.android.com/guide/components/intents-common#DialPhone

## Acceptance (AC-4)
- [ ] Mobile case view → tap Call senior → OS dialer opens with the on-call senior moderator's E.164 number prefilled.
- [ ] No on-call configured → button shows "No senior on duty" and disables the tap.
- [ ] Phone numbers never appear in logs or in federation wire records.

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #119.
- Blocks #121 (hardware-key enforcement is the security hardening pass).
